The '''western outskirts''' were an area on the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] that contained [[Sector 3 (Ryloth)|Sector 3]]. Early in the [[Imperial Era]], a [[Rescue of Hera Syndulla (Ryloth)|skirmish]] took place there between the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] and [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military|forces]].<ref name="Devil's Deal" />
